schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Crates: minor and patch updates together. Cargo.lock is kept to versions that build with rust-version (resolver 3), which Renovate never changes.
ignore 0.4.30 needs Rust 1.88 and does not declare it. Remove this rule together with the limit in the Cargo.toml files when rust-version is 1.88.
aya 0.14 needs Rust 1.87, and Debian 13 has 1.85. Remove this rule together with the limit in keyboard-state/Cargo.toml when rust-version is 1.87.
Actions: a new version is not taken before it has been out for three days.
The base images of the local containers and the container of the aports job, pinned by digest: the updates of tags and digests together in one pull request.
